meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点并设计工程方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果从事治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计与优化。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites and engineer glycoproteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on glycosylation design for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以分析蛋白质序列中的N-糖基化位点（N-X-S/T），预测O-糖基化热点，并提供糖工程工具（NetOGlyc、GlycoShield、GlycoWorkbench）的使用指导。它会输出糖基化分析报告和突变建议。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白质序列并询问糖基化分析、抗体工程、疫苗设计或治疗性蛋白优化时触发。

say.text: 分析这段IgG1 Fc区的N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude会扫描序列并列出所有N-糖基化位点。

say.text: 预测这个蛋白序列的O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude会使用启发式算法预测Ser/Thr富集区域。
Claude会提供命令行示例和说明。

howto.what_en: With this skill enabled, Claude can analyze protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and provide guidance on using glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). It outputs glycosylation analysis reports and mutation suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a protein sequence and requests glycosylation analysis, antibody engineering, vaccine design, or therapeutic protein optimization.

say_en.text: Analyze N-glycosylation sites in this IgG1 Fc sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the sequence and list all sequons.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Claude uses a heuristic algorithm to flag Ser/Thr-rich regions.

say_en.text: How to use GlycoShield-MD for glycan shielding analysis?
say_en.note: Claude provides command-line instructions and examples.
